tagline: PvP on. Bases protected. Raiding by mutual war only.
summary: PvP is on everywhere, but bases are protected.
You can only raid a side you are at war with, and both sides must agree to the war.
No racism or bigotry. Swearing and banter are fine.
No cheating, no exploiting. Type /rules in game for the full rules.

sections.title: The Basics
rules: Don't be a dick. Most of these rules come down to that.
Admin decisions are final. If you think one's wrong, take it to Discord, not global chat.
By playing here you agree to these rules. "I didn't read them" isn't a defence.

sections.title: Chat & Conduct
rules: Swearing, banter and trash talk are fine. This is an adult server.
**No racism, homophobia, transphobia or other bigotry.** That covers slurs, "jokes" and names. Expect a ban, not a warning.
No threats involving real life. No doxxing, and no posting anyone's personal info.
No spamming, advertising other servers, or excessive caps.
Harassment is out. Winding someone up once is banter. Following them around the map for an hour isn't.
Offensive player names, clan tags or signs get removed, and you may be too.

sections.title: PvE, PvP & Raiding
rules: **PvP is on.** You can be killed anywhere, anytime.
**Bases are protected.** You cannot damage another player's base unless your sides are at war (see Wars).
No griefing around the protection rules. Don't wall people in, block monuments, or build to trap players or loot.
Loot left in the open is fair game. Loot in someone's base isn't, unless you're at war with them.

sections.title: Wars
rules: Players, teams and clans can declare war with **/war declare**. Both sides have to agree.
Once accepted, there's a **5-minute truce**, then both sides can raid any base with an enemy on the TC.
Wars last **24 hours** or until both sides agree to peace with **/war peace**.
Don't want to be raided? Use **/war autodecline** and nobody can declare on you.
Don't pressure or threaten people into accepting a war. If they decline, they decline.
Don't hop between teams or clans to dodge a war you agreed to. You stay locked in until it ends.
Don't park a war base on someone else's TC or next to a neutral base to drag them into it.

sections.title: Building
rules: Max team or clan size: **[X]**. Alliances that get round this aren't allowed.
Don't build in or block monuments, roads, rail lines or event areas.
Keep your base a reasonable distance from others. No building right on top of someone's base.
Abandoned bases decay as normal. Admins may remove anything that's causing server lag.

sections.title: Raid Bases
rules: Raid bases belong to whoever starts them. Don't interfere with someone else's raid.
Don't exploit the bases, for example by glitching through walls or using bugs to take loot.

sections.title: Cheating & Exploits
rules: **No cheats, scripts, macros or third-party tools.** That's a permanent ban with no appeal.
No exploiting bugs. If you find one, report it on Discord and you might get a reward.
Playing with a known cheater, or "not knowing" your teammate was cheating, can get the whole team banned.
Alt accounts used to get round bans or rules get banned along with the main account.

sections.title: Staff & Punishments
rules: Punishments depend on how serious it is: warning, mute, kick, temporary ban, permanent ban. Admins can skip straight to a ban.
Report problems on Discord with evidence (screenshots or clips). Don't start drama in global chat.
Staff won't spawn items or help one side in a war.
Wipe schedule: **[e.g. Map every Thursday, blueprints monthly]**.
